title: Choose Portal's new visual world
question: Portal needs to make its floating multi-AI desktop workflow instantly understandable. Choose the direction that should carry into the full redesign brief.

options.label: The Optical Switchboard
options.lineage: precision optical benches and lens calibration plates
options.thesis: Portal becomes the instrument that brings several official AI services into one focused desktop view.
options.viewport: A full-width ultrawide product film sits inside a calibrated glass stage while a large violet aperture selects the AI service.
options.risk: The instrument language can feel clinical if copy and controls become too technical.

raised.raise: Proof unfolds in visible, named stages instead of a generic feature list.
One responsive refraction field carries motion while the rest of the page stays composed.
Selected services and download states read as tangible active states.
Layers register in sequence so every reveal explains structure.
Controlled overlap demonstrates browser-tab consolidation without visual clutter.

options.label: The Window Choreographer
options.lineage: desktop window managers and spatial workspace switchers
options.thesis: The page choreographs multiple official AI windows around one always-close Portal surface.
options.viewport: The real showcase film fills a desktop canvas while compact AI windows collapse into the Portal widget around it.
options.risk: It is the clearest option, but also the closest to familiar desktop-software marketing.

options.label: The Event Horizon
options.lineage: a black-hole accretion disk at the edge of disappearance
options.thesis: Portal is a controlled gravitational center that pulls scattered AI tabs into one reachable orbit.
options.viewport: A monumental portal ring bends the ultrawide film across the fold while service names orbit as selectable destinations.
options.case: Strong audience identification and memorable motion; weaker product clarity because spectacle can outrun the desktop utility.
options.risk: It can slip into generic sci-fi or gaming language if the product film stops leading.

options.label: The Batch Shelf
options.thesis: Each Portal capability matures through clearly labeled stages on a working shelf.
options.viewport: A seasonal shelf turns services and setup steps into a collection of labeled vessels.
options.case: The progression system is clear, but food craft has no credible relationship to desktop AI work.
options.risk: The metaphor would distract from the product rather than explain it.
options.kept: Named progress stages strengthen installation guides.

options.label: The Fluid Basin
options.lineage: a shallow basin of suminagashi ink
options.thesis: Portal's movement becomes one continuous field of responsive ink and current.
options.viewport: The showcase film rests beside an interactive marbling field that responds to the visitor's pointer.
options.case: The motion is distinctive, but marbling does not identify the multi-service desktop workflow.
options.risk: The interaction becomes decorative atmosphere instead of product proof.
options.kept: One orchestrated responsive material should carry the motion system.

options.label: The Live Counter
options.thesis: Every selected service arrives as a visible change of physical state inside a desktop instrument.
options.viewport: Portal's service choices occupy a bank of glowing physical indicators below the product film.
options.case: The active states are excellent, but quantities and retro electronics do not explain Portal's core task.
options.risk: A nostalgic instrument aesthetic would overcomplicate a simple utility.
options.kept: Controls need unmistakable, tactile active states.

options.label: The Registered Print
options.lineage: a folk woodblock print on crushed-shell paper
options.thesis: Portal's story prints layer by layer until one complete desktop workflow comes into register.
options.viewport: A centered Portal mark and product film assemble in separate color layers across a shimmering paper field.
options.case: The craft is memorable, but the print language weakens identification with modern desktop software.
options.risk: The visual world could turn Portal into a cultural poster instead of a useful product.
options.kept: Layered reveals should register in a deliberate explanatory sequence.

options.label: The Tool Case
options.lineage: a road case buried under layered stickers
options.thesis: The AI tools accumulated across a workday become a visible stack that Portal compresses into order.
options.viewport: Overlapping service labels peel away to reveal the clean Portal widget and showcase film beneath.
options.case: The tool accumulation is recognizable, but its clutter contradicts Portal's unobtrusive purpose.
options.risk: The page would feel noisy and youthful where the product promises focus.
options.kept: Controlled overlap can demonstrate browser-tab consolidation.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished dark desktop-software landing page that keeps every interaction familiar.
canonCard.viewport: A centered headline and Download button sit above the showcase film, followed by a feature-card grid.
canonCard.risk: It is easy to understand and equally easy to confuse with another AI product website.
